## Regeneration note (F4)

The MagLS phase recursion amplifies roundoff, so MagLS taps are not unique: byte-identical regeneration is a same-machine / same-BLAS property. On this machine with the pinned environment the header reproduces byte-identically (compare the sha256 above). Elsewhere, compare on the objective table and the oracle null (≤ 1e-9 against spaudiopy), not on bytes. The committed header is the canonical artifact.
